_about: The fixed requests eval-outfits runs. Keep them the same between prompt versions so runs are comparable; when you change one, start a new baseline. Each request: id (short, unique), details (what you'd type in the builder), and optionally count (1-5, default 3), riskiness (safe, stretch or bold; leave out for a mix) and anchors (garment IDs to build around).
